title: One More Thing!
para1: When I'm in a normal mood, if you ask me to press the lever to start the machine, you are guaranteed that I'll do it. But in half of the sessions I will be in a cheeky mood: in some of the rounds I will refuse to press the lever when you ask me to. If I refuse to do it, I give you back the ${{bet_amount}}, and you move on to the next round.
